glossary.specification repository: the private repository Ultra-Brain-Legacy (specifications and judgment records)
glossary.Owner: the individual user who makes the final decisions of the project
glossary.designated core tests: 191 tests within the full regression that must pass
glossary.exempt set: 81 failing or erroring tests the Owner exempted, with recorded reasons, in earlier releases
glossary.new regression: a test that passed in the previous baseline run and now fails or errors
glossary.missing: a planned test with no recorded result
glossary.upper median: the larger of the two middle values of the sorted samples
glossary.latency budget: the ceiling the specification sets (38 µs for the pipe round trip)
glossary.baseline run: the measured commit is compared with the full regression run of the previous change (commit 0fd4b0f, 2026-11-24), the final commit with the measured commit's run
glossary.drydock: internal name of the self-verification instrument
glossary.observed_message_lengths_after_splitting: the message lengths the library-level observation concerned: the whole length for single and burst sends, each half for split sends
glossary.stress_core_library_corrected: the stress run of the core library after the test tool's expectation was corrected (60 cases re-classified PASS)
glossary.protected source files: files whose SHA-256 the regression harness checks before every batch; a change voids the run
glossary.command_results: the engine's own decision for each test command (APPROVED or NOT_APPROVED); the decision is part of the measured cycle, not a pass or fail of the measurement
glossary.engine_selftest_process: whole-process time of the engine's built-in self-test
glossary.python_pipe_open_4_instances: time to create the four pipe instances and connect both ends
glossary.vaccine test class: a group of vaccine tests; private_until_split = would become a candidate if the modules it uses were split from private ones; private_only = never a candidate
glossary.self-verification instrument: the project's own tool that runs and records tests and checks one item at a time
glossary.tier: attack stage: 1 front door, 2 assume breach, 3 AI-agent cheating and fuzzing
glossary.breached / partial / blocked: got past a guard / reproduced a named residual risk or partly succeeded / stopped by a guard
glossary.BLOCKED: a test or attack that could not be run
glossary.approval token: a single-use approval ticket signed by the Owner, valid for one risky action
glossary.leak detector: a check that blocks private files from entering the public derivative repository
glossary.times: UTC unless a field says otherwise

implementation_judgment: round 1 blocking findings: Opus 1 / Sonnet 0 / Fable 1. In the Demo classification record one vaccine whose subject reaches private modules was marked a candidate, and the vaccine classification was not measured. After the fix, round 2: 0 / 0 / 0. The judging models checked the tests by mutation testing, and the tests were strengthened whenever an alteration went undetected. In one round 1 commit, two child processes started by the new tests were not registered in the list of permitted process-launch sites, so the test that checks that list failed once. The next commit registered them.
